summary: Draganfly Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 12, 2026 press release announcing formation of Draganfly Defense USA, Inc., a dedicated U.S. defense subsidiary. Former Acting Secretary of the Navy Thomas Modly was appointed Chairman of the new unit and will relinquish his Draganfly Inc. board seat per regulatory requirements; CEO Cameron Chell joins as director, with Brig. Gen. AJ Pasagian (Ret.) as President. No deal terms, financial consideration, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock were disclosed. The event is a governance change tied to a new subsidiary, not an M&A or capital transaction. Watch for any future spin-off, capital raise, or contract awards tied to the defense unit.
